meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: Claude 会当主持人,把每个 git 分支、工作树或 PR 当成一个发言者,让它们在共享聊天记录里轮流介绍自己的改动、回应冲突,最后把结论写成一份合并方案:以哪个分支为基础、按什么顺序合并、哪些决定留给你。整个过程只读,不真正合并代码。
howto.when: 当你要求把多个分支、工作树或 PR 的改动整合成一份合并方案时触发。没指定时间范围时,Claude 会提供 1 小时、4 小时、24 小时等窗口;候选对象不足两个时,它会说明无法站会并建议扩大范围。

say.text: 帮我开个只读站会,把最近开发的分支汇成一份合并计划。
say.note: Claude 会先确认参与对象,再开始逐轮讨论。

say.text: 这几天的分支和那两个 PR 一起,讨论好合并顺序再给我定夺。
say.note: 各分支/PR 会先自我介绍,冲突会单独追问。

say.text: 先不要合并,报告哪些分支有实际代码,哪些是空壳。
say.note: 用于最终汇总前的判断。

howto.what_en: Claude hosts a read-only standup: each git branch/PR speaks in a shared chat file, introduces changes, resolves conflicts in rounds. It then writes one consolidation plan (target worktree + merge order + human decisions), without merging.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to consolidate multiple branches/worktrees/PRs into one plan. Without a window, Claude offers 1h/4h/24h/7d; fewer than two candidates stops the standup and suggests widening.

say_en.text: Run a read-only standup for my recent branches and give me one merge plan.
say_en.note: Claude confirms participants and starts the rounds.

say_en.text: Discuss these branches and those PRs, then propose a merge order I can approve.
Don't merge yet; tell me which branches have real code and which are empty.
say_en.note: Helps you decide before approving the plan.
